# OA.6 Replication {#rep}

Every table and figure of the paper's quantitative sections and of this appendix, except the paper's figure 5.1 of
Argentina's beneficiaries, is produced by the pipeline in `python/paper` of the
[repository](https://github.com/ChampionApe/SSDclaude), in three stages: the calibrations, the experiments, and a
build that reads only their results and writes the exhibits in seconds. `REPLICATION.md` in the repository is the
map from data and code to every output, with the commands and the time each stage takes; the technical
documentation [@BergGE26doc] describes the model, its equilibria and the algorithms.

The table lists every exhibit shown here, where it appears and the builder that makes it[, with the files it
reads; each exhibit's *Source* has the same, with downloads and the command that rebuilds it]{.content-visible when-format="html"}.
